prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for the Scamagotchi browser game.
Primary request: ONE coherent atlas of FOUR beautifully drawn fictional SGD specimen banknotes in exactly TWO equal columns and TWO equal rows. Wide canvas with overall aspect ratio exactly 2:1, each equal cell therefore 2:1 too. Notes face directly forward, perfectly flat, horizontal, no perspective or rotation. Each note fills about 94% of its own cell width and height with equal transparent margin. All four have identical dimensions and aligned rectangular stepped outlines. Transparent alpha between and around notes. No overlapping notes, stacks, shadows, captions outside notes, or UI.

Visual language: polished handcrafted 16-bit pixel illustration matching the supplied game references: warm ivory paper, stepped charcoal/plum outlines, careful coloured pixel clusters, miniature Singapore life scenes, quiet ornate pixel border, charming detailed chibi illustration quality. Crisp pixels, no blurry anti-aliased gradients, no realistic money photography, no plastic/vector clipart. These should feel like collectible game items, rich and thoughtfully illustrated, NOT copied real Singapore banknotes.

Four distinct notes, exact fixed locations:
TOP LEFT: purple and lavender S$2 note, illustrated Singapore neighbourhood HDB flats, schoolbook and small tropical leaves.
TOP RIGHT: warm coral and muted red S$10 note, illustrated campus courtyard and open book beneath tropical canopy.
BOTTOM LEFT: cool blue and pale teal S$50 note, illustrated Singapore skyline and riverside city details.
BOTTOM RIGHT: amber-orange and warm ochre S$100 note, illustrated heritage shophouse street and leafy garden.

On EVERY note: large clear denomination at upper right and lower left, using respectively "2", "10", "50", "100" in its cell. Small readable uppercase "SGD" beside the lower-left denomination. Restrained uppercase "SINGAPORE" along upper left. A broad high-contrast ivory stamp ribbon across the lower-middle reading EXACTLY "SPECIMEN", spelled S P E C I M E N, in dark chunky pixel capitals, large enough to remain obvious at 200px note width. Keep the mini landscape visible above the ribbon and frame the numerals cleanly. No tiny illegible paragraphs. No real person portrait, no official crest, no serial number, no signatures, no counterfeit security features, no legal-tender statement. All numbers must match the note's denomination without invented extras.

Input images are STYLE/QUALITY references only: preserve the rich pixel rendering and calm cream/plum game palette, not the reference UI or banknote portrait. Deliver only the four-note atlas, true transparent background.
